name: media-script-writer
description: Writes the script for a generated video before anything is generated, in one of two modes: Cinematic (premise, want against need, a turn, escalation, resolution) or Ad (hook, problem, demo, proof, offer and tagline beats on a clock), delivered as a timed shot table. Every row carries a cut length and a generated length the route can render, a voiceover or dialogue line held to a word cap computed from the speaking voice's registry rate, and a continuity cell naming what carries in from the row above. No model calls; text and timing arithmetic only. Use when: write a script, ad script, commercial, promo, product ad, story, short film, brand film, narrative video, VO script, shot list, storyboard copy, beat sheet, AI video screenplay, timed narration, or turn a brief into shots. NOT for: wording one shot's visual prompt (media-shot-craft); generating clips (media-video-generation); generating the voiceover (media-audio-generation); assembling a finished video (media-video-production).
